segments.title: October
segments.text: Hello Kenkere House! October is the Festival of Lights. Dhanteras, Diwali, gifting season, and a lot of very good sweets. This month, we sell sparkle: upgrades, gifts, and a golden annual membership that lasts longer than any box of kaju katli.

segments.title: ₹5.57L
segments.text: So, the number. Our October target for Kenkere House is 5.57 lakh rupees. That's 15 per cent above last October. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 2.95 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 1.89 lakh, everything else 39,000, and comebacks 33,400. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 28 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 417 leads, 150 trials, and 28 buyers, with about 19 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 4.54 lakh rupees, which is 82 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: From Phuljhadi to Anaar
segments.text: First up, From Phuljhadi to Anaar. Monthly members upgrade to six months at twenty per cent off, with three extra freezes for the festive madness. Small sparkle to big sparkle. The plan is 5 buyers at about 47,000, so 2.35 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 1 Month or class packs.

segments.title: Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box
segments.text: Next, Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box. Gift three classes for the price of two. If the recipient joins, the giver earns a bonus class. Nobody needs a fourteenth box of almonds. The plan is 8 buyers at about 2,800, so 22,700 rupees.

segments.title: Diwali Cleaning: Found Your Old Grip Socks?
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Diwali Cleaning. Found your old grip socks? That's a sign. Fifteen per cent off the return, and a brand-new pair of socks on us. The plan is 6 buyers at about 12,400, so 74,400 rupees.

segments.title: Gold Rush (Dhanteras Edition)
segments.text: And finally, for Dhanteras, Gold Rush. An annual at twenty-two per cent off, an extra private, and a gold-foil card, for seventy-two hours only. Gold that actually lifts. The plan is 1 buyer at about 1.22 lakh, so 1.22 lakh rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every monthly member hears the anaar upgrade pitch. Week two, gift cards go live at the desk, online and in office inboxes. Week three, Dhanteras, and the gold annual for seventy-two hours only. Week four, Diwali cleaning brings old members home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's October at Kenkere House. 5.57 lakh rupees, four offers, and 28 buyers to welcome. Lights on, targets lit. Happy Diwali.
